# Draft:Nonexisty (Battle for Dream Island)

Nonexisty is a character that was up for debut in Battle for Dream Island, Battle for Dream Island Again, IDFB, and Battle for Dream Island: The Power of Two.
In IDFB, Nonexisty is currently in the Tiny Loser Chamber due to failing to debut in BFDIA. He had a chance to join the season but only received 501 votes, which was not enough to rejoin and placed him 9th to join the season.
